verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Amazon IVS ships official broadcast SDKs for Android and iOS that let users join as hosts or viewers on a real-time stage, which covers the client-connection part of the story. Nothing in the pack documents creating a stage or session from a server, minting scoped participant join tokens, or a short end-to-end quickstart. missing for 10: server-side session/stage creation API evidence, scoped join-token minting, a documented short end-to-end flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a session from my server, mint a scoped join token, and connect a client with the official SDK in a short documented flow

citations.quote: By integrating the Amazon IVS broadcast SDKs for Android and iOS, your users can engage as hosts or viewers, enjoying high-quality live streams on their mobile devices.
Integrate into interactive apps with chat APIs, and Player and Broadcast SDKs for mobile and web.
